profile.headline: Software Engineer with expertise in FreeBSD and network drivers.
profile.summary: Working with increasingly inscrutable systems/software is fine with me.

positions.title: Network Software Engineer
positions.description:
I developed and maintained FreeBSD network interface drivers for Intel Ethernet products.

These included almost all of the Intel products for servers and datacenters.
positions.insights: Skills: C · Device Drivers · Software Development · Kernel Debugging · Continuous Integration (CI) · Git · Unit Testing · Virtualization · C++

positions.title: Undergraduate Hourly / Paraprofessional
positions.description:
- Wrote PERL scripts and XSLT stylesheets that (batch) transformed XML files
- Created Python 3 scripts and more XSLT stylesheets that scraped data from websites on the internet and inserted it into XML files that were transformed from other formats.
- Created an ASP.NET WCF (C#) service that received a URL, retrieved HTML and XML files from a couple different websites, formatted and returned a JSON response that was used in a client-side Javascript/JQueryUI modal dialog.
positions.insights: Skills: XML · Perl · XSLT · Python (Programming Language) · Software Development
